chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār and al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar, who both said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “The affluent ones among our Shiʿah are our trustees over their needy ones, so safeguard us concerning them; may Allah safeguard you.”

key_terms.أُمَنَاؤُنَا: our trustees, those entrusted with a responsibility
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: our Shiʿah, the followers devoted to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.فَاحْفَظُونَا: so safeguard us, meaning preserve our right and trust in this matter
key_terms.مَحَاوِيجِهِمْ: their needy ones, those in need among them

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about the responsibility of wealthy Shiʿah toward the poor?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the wealthy among the Shiʿah hold a trust toward the needy members of their community. Fulfilling the rights of the poor is presented as safeguarding the cause and honor of the Imam عليه السلام, and it is linked to divine protection from Allah.
